types.doc: How one device that attaches an account is getting on with it.
types.name: AccountDevice

types.doc: An issuer an app describes, to connect a person's account there (`CONNECT_ACCOUNT`): its endpoints, what it is asked for, which fields of its identity answer name the account, and the one loopback port its client registered `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/oauth` for.
types.name: AccountIssuer

types.doc: The kind of service an account is.
types.name: AccountKind

types.doc: Which of an account's services the person uses.
types.name: AccountServices

types.doc: How an account's last sync went, as a person reads it on the account's row.
types.name: AccountStatus

types.doc: One account the workspace connected, without its secret.
types.name: AccountView

types.doc: One of a calendar account's calendars, as its person chooses which show.
types.name: CalendarView

types.doc: An account its person connected at an issuer an app describes: who they are there, never what signs them in.
types.name: ConnectedAccount

types.doc: A login of the workspace's vault, as `SIGN_INS` lists it: where it belongs, never what it signs in with.
types.name: MailSignIn

types.doc: Every login of the workspace's vault (`SIGN_INS`), each with the account it signs in for.
types.name: MailSignIns

types.doc: Where the person's browser goes to sign in, and what the sign-in waits for.
types.name: SignInStep

types.doc: An account of the workspace's that has a sign-in, as `SIGN_INS` shows it to the app that signs it in: where it signs in, never what it signs in with.
types.name: SignedInAccount

verbs.description: List mail accounts The mail accounts the workspace's vault keeps, as a `MailAccounts`.
verbs.label: List mail accounts

verbs.description: Follow the mail accounts The same accounts as `list`, sent again whenever they change, until the caller cancels: what a window follows so an account added in another one reaches it without asking again.
verbs.label: Follow the mail accounts

verbs.description: Add a mail account Adds a mail account once its server accepted its sign-in, and answers it as a `MailAccount`.
verbs.label: Add a mail account

schema.description: Which of an account's services the person uses. One account feeds every app: Mail reads it where `mail` is on, Calendar where `calendar` is.

verbs.description: Add a mail account from the vault Adds a mail account whose sign-in the workspace's vault already keeps, and answers it as a `MailAccount`. The password is named by reference and the host resolves it, only for the two servers the item belongs to. It carries no secret, so unlike `add-mail` an agent acting for the person may ask it.
verbs.label: Add a mail account from the vault

verbs.description: Connect a calendar server Connects a calendar account at a `CalDAV` server its person names, once that server took the sign-in, and answers it as a `MailAccount`: what a person who rents a calendar from no mail provider connects.
verbs.label: Connect a calendar server

verbs.description: Sign an account in again Signs the account in again with the entry the workspace's vault keeps for it, through the same sign-in the account was added with: the accounts reading then says how it went.
verbs.label: Sign an account in again

verbs.description: Check an account's server Checks that an account's server still takes the sign-in the workspace's vault keeps, answering the probe's own words `{ "result": "…" }`, or the reason it refused them. Nothing is written.
verbs.label: Check an account's server

verbs.description: Replace an account's sign-in Replaces an account's saved sign-in once the server took the new one: the vault's entry is the account's own, under the same reference.
verbs.label: Replace an account's sign-in

verbs.description: Remove an account Removes an account and its secret, answering the accounts that remain as a `MailAccounts`.
verbs.label: Remove an account

verbs.description: Find an account's calendars Asks a calendar account's server for the calendars it holds and keeps them on the account, keeping the choice its person made for the ones it held before: what the review shows before they choose.
verbs.label: Find an account's calendars

verbs.description: Choose an account's calendars The others keep their events out of the calendar on this workspace's devices.
verbs.label: Choose an account's calendars

verbs.description: Find where an address's mail lives Worked out from the address alone, answering `FoundServers`. Nothing signs in: the person sees the servers before they type a password for them.
verbs.label: Find where an address's mail lives

verbs.description: Sign in to an account on its provider's page Answers where the person's browser goes. The server finishes the sign-in itself when the provider sends the browser back, keeps the account, and every window following `watch` sees it arrive; until then `MailAccounts::signing_in` names it.
verbs.label: Sign in to an account on its provider's page

schema.description: Where the person's browser goes to sign in, and what the sign-in waits for.

code.description: What the sign-in waits for beyond the browser, in words the person reads: a verification code Apple sent them, or the code a provider showed instead of redirecting back. Empty when it needs none.

id.description: The sign-in's id, as `MailAccounts::signing_in` and `CANCEL_SIGN_IN` name it.

verbs.description: Stop waiting for a sign-in Stops waiting for a sign-in begun on a provider's page, or forgets one that failed, answering the accounts as `MailAccounts`.
verbs.label: Stop waiting for a sign-in

verbs.description: Choose an account's services Answers the accounts as `MailAccounts`.
verbs.label: Choose an account's services

verbs.description: Read the logins the vault keeps Their names, sign-in names, the places each belongs to and the account each signs in for, never their secrets. An app picks from them the ones its own places name, as Mail's does for its `imap` and `smtp` servers and Calendar's for its `https` server; an item's secret comes only from `vault#release`.
verbs.label: Read the logins the vault keeps

schema.description: Every login of the workspace's vault (`SIGN_INS`), each with the account it signs in for.

items.description: A login of the workspace's vault, as `SIGN_INS` lists it: where it belongs, never what it signs in with.

account.description: The account of the workspace's it signs in for, where the workspace keeps one for it.

address.description: The address or name it signs in at.

enabled.description: Whether the account is in use.

id.description: The account's id, as every action names it.

kind.description: The kind of account it is (`caldav`, `email`).

readOnly.description: Whether nothing is ever written to its server.

server.description: The server it signs in to, where its settings name one.

settings.description: The account's settings an app that signs in reads: its servers, its ports and the name it signs in as, and the vault entry that keeps its secret.

id.description: The item's reference, as `ADD_MAIL_WITH_ITEM` names it.

places.description: The places it belongs to, each as the vault keeps one: `imap://<host>:<port>`, `smtp://<host>:<port>`, `https://<host>` and the like.

title.description: What Passwords shows the entry as.

username.description: The name it signs in with.

verbs.description: Choose how an account's files are kept Whether a cloud-storage account's files stay in sync or are copied into the workspace once, answering the accounts as `MailAccounts`.
verbs.label: Choose how an account's files are kept

verbs.description: Read the accounts a cloud mount keeps Each account's settings, and whether its person signed in, never its secret (a `CloudAccounts`). Answered only to the person on a connection of their own.
verbs.label: Read the accounts a cloud mount keeps

verbs.description: Sign a cloud mount in What a device's cloud mount for the account signs in with now, answered as a `CloudCredential` in the receipt alone: its password, or the access token of the grant the workspace's vault keeps, renewed when it was due or when the mount refused the last one. The renewed grant is kept in the workspace's vault, never by the mount. Answered only to the person on a connection of their own.
verbs.label: Sign a cloud mount in

verbs.description: Say how a device's sync of an account goes How the device's sync of the account goes, as every member's Settings reads it: what its cloud mount or the app that speaks to the account's server reports. The row written is the reporting device's own; a report that names another device is refused.
verbs.label: Say how a device's sync of an account goes

verbs.description: Sync an account now Cuts a failure's wait short and tries an account whose mount could not start.
verbs.label: Sync an account now

verbs.description: Pause an account's sync Stops a cloud-storage account's background sync and uploads until it is resumed; reads still fetch on demand.
verbs.label: Pause an account's sync

verbs.description: Resume an account's sync Resumes a paused cloud-storage account and syncs it now.
verbs.label: Resume an account's sync

verbs.description: Connect cloud storage Answers where the person's browser goes. A sign-in the provider shows a code for, or iCloud's, is finished with `submit-sign-in-code`; one approved on the provider's page finishes itself and the accounts reading shows the account arrive.
verbs.label: Connect cloud storage

schema.description: Where the person's browser goes to sign in, and what the sign-in waits for.

code.description: What the sign-in waits for beyond the browser, in words the person reads: a verification code Apple sent them, or the code a provider showed instead of redirecting back. Empty when it needs none.

id.description: The sign-in's id, as `MailAccounts::signing_in` and `CANCEL_SIGN_IN` name it.

verbs.description: Finish signing in with a code iCloud's verification code, or the code a provider showed instead of redirecting back. Answers the accounts as `MailAccounts` once the account is kept.
verbs.label: Finish signing in with a code

verbs.description: Connect an account at an app's issuer Connects the person's account at an issuer an app describes, so the app can tell who they are there: answered with where their browser goes, and finished with `finish-connect-account`. Only a person asks it, from that app. The grant stays in their vault; the app reads back only the account the issuer confirmed, its id and name, and only for issuers it described itself.
verbs.label: Connect an account at an app's issuer

schema.description: An issuer an app describes, to connect a person's account there (`CONNECT_ACCOUNT`): its endpoints, what it is asked for, which fields of its identity answer name the account, and the one loopback port its client registered `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/oauth` for. Data, never code: every issuer is signed in to the same way.

id.description: Unique among the issuers one app describes.

idField.description: The identity answer's field holding the account's stable id.

identityEndpoint.description: Answers the signed-in account to its access token.

nameField.description: The identity answer's field holding the name the account goes by.

revocationEndpoint.description: Where a grant is given back when the person forgets the account, if the issuer has one.

schema.description: Where the person's browser goes to sign in, and what the sign-in waits for.

code.description: What the sign-in waits for beyond the browser, in words the person reads: a verification code Apple sent them, or the code a provider showed instead of redirecting back. Empty when it needs none.

id.description: The sign-in's id, as `MailAccounts::signing_in` and `CANCEL_SIGN_IN` name it.

verbs.description: Wait for a connected account Waits for a `connect-account` to come back from the person's browser, answering the `ConnectedAccount` the issuer confirmed, or why it did not, in words the person reads.
verbs.label: Wait for a connected account

schema.description: An account its person connected at an issuer an app describes: who they are there, never what signs them in.

app.description: The app that described the issuer.

id.description: The account's id at the issuer.

issuer.description: The issuer's id, as that app describes it.

name.description: The name the account goes by there.

verbs.description: Forget a connected account Its grant leaves the person's vault and is given back to the issuer where it takes one back. Only the person asks it.
verbs.label: Forget a connected account

verbs.description: Keep a website sign-in Keeps the cookies a browser on one of the person's computers was signed in to sites with as one of the workspace's accounts, its cookies sealed in the workspace's vault: the person's Browser opens those sites signed in with them. Keeping it again under its id keeps the newer cookies in place of the older ones. Only the person asks it.
verbs.label: Keep a website sign-in
